title: Ambiguous 'sort out the Northwind thing': look before asking, then do it

chat.label: ask
chat.goal: You want the assistant to deal with Sam Whitaker's latest email about the Northwind renewal next steps: draft a reply that proposes a call Thursday afternoon. You phrase it vaguely and only clarify if really needed. Approve the draft if it's decent and tell it to send.
chat.opener: can you sort out the northwind thing

checks.label: reply to Sam sent or drafted

said.not: could you (please )?clarify what you mean|what do you mean by

judge: The bot looks in his mail first and figures out 'the Northwind thing' is Sam Whitaker's renewal next-steps email, says what it found in a line, proposes or drafts a reply (asking at most one useful question, e.g. what time works), and sends it once Daniel approves. No 'can you clarify?' before looking. Terse to match him.
